title: Delivery Lead
description:
TLDR:
Own the customer accounts running construction and infrastructure projects on Planlab, and be responsible for their success and growth. We’re looking for a generalist who can understand complex problems, design the right solution and get it built and adopted, using AI coding agents and the platform, with associates working alongside you. London, £100–160k + 0.5–1.0% equity grant, visa sponsorship available.

500.
About Us
We're an AI-first company, and that starts with our own work. We automate what we can and do old-school what we must, building the tools and knowledge that teams of humans and AIs need to run construction and infrastructure projects.
Our product consists of two halves: a customer-facing platform that runs both standard and bespoke project scheduling apps, supports large-scale datasets, complex integrations and large groups of users and runs an AI copilot; and an internal AI operating system that automates and supports our own work. It dials into meetings, analyses customers' screen-shares and shared datasets, builds implementation plans, orchestrates coding agents and validation systems - and pushes PRs.
We're a small team in London (8 people), growing fast, and looking for people who see a problem and run at it - figuring things out, and not stopping at
“
that's not my job.
”
Any new joiner can make a big difference. We raised our Seed round earlier this year at a ~$25m valuation, and are now aggressively scaling the business.
Our customers are large contractors, infrastructure builders and asset owners. They build railways, highways, airports, power plants, solar farms, steel mills and more. We work with them to improve the construction schedules for these assets.
The Role
Planlab is an AI project controls platform, with customer-specific layers on top: custom agent skills and workflows, agentic reporting, and integrations with the customer's own systems. The Delivery Lead owns the full customer lifecycle: understanding the customer's world deeply, designing the right solution, and getting it delivered using AI coding agents and the platform.
This is a hands-on role. Associates work alongside you on training, rollouts and first-line support, but you build custom features for customers yourself, not just run meetings. It suits someone who thrives on ambiguity: the problems are messy, the customers are large, and much of what we do is being worked out for the first time.
What We Offer
Salary ranging £100k to £160k for promising profiles
Share options ranging from 0.5% – 1.0% (4-year vest, 1-year cliff, fully diluted)
Nice office in London with some flexibility on hybrid
Skilled worker visa sponsorship if needed - we’re a very international team
Highly entrepreneurial environment
All the equipment, software and tokens you need to do the best job
Unlimited headroom to grow
Responsibilities
Own the customer relationship end to end for 1
–
5 accounts, from onboarding through to expanding into new use cases and projects
Deeply understand each customer's project controls problems and operational context
Solve the customer's problems, in whatever way works
Design workflows and customisation layers that solve the problem without you there to do it
Implement solutions using AI coding agents, working on top of the Planlab platform
Work alongside and support the associates on your accounts
Collaborate with platform engineers when deeper platform changes are needed
Validate product decisions with the right stakeholders at the customer
What We're Looking For
Strong product design intuition: can translate ambiguous customer needs into concrete workflows
Excellent structured communicator: can explain their work clearly at any time, to anyone
Model-driven thinker: can take a messy problem, build a mental model of how it works, and use that to break it into concrete steps
Effective at directing AI coding agents to build and iterate on solutions
Able to prioritise across several accounts and support more junior colleagues
Comfortable with ambiguity and change in an early-stage startup; the bar here is highest of any role in the team
Ideal Backgrounds
Early-stage startup generalists who have worn many hats
Technical consulting (BCG X, McKinsey Digital/QB, Bain ADAPT, or similar)
Generalist consultants with a strong technical background: proven problem solvers and modellers, engineering or computer science degrees
Product managers or technical PMs with delivery experience
Customer delivery or success roles at product companies (e.g. Palantir deployment strategist or forward-deployed roles)
Interested in this role?
Send us your CV and a short note about why you'd be a great fit.
Apply at the address on the job page

Planlab is an AI project controls platform, with customer-specific layers on top: custom agent skills and workflows, agentic reporting, and integrations with the customer's own systems. The Delivery Associate makes delivery actually happen: preparing and running training, coordinating rollouts across business units, supporting users day to day and feeding what you learn back into the product.
You'll present to customers and run sessions with them yourself, not just in the background. Keen generalists and people with a more technical background are both welcome. Either way there's a path into building customisations on the platform yourself, into leading accounts, or into other parts of the company.
What We Offer
Salary ranging £70k to £110k depending on experience
Share options ranging from 0.25% – 0.5% (4-year vest, 1-year cliff, fully diluted)
Nice office in London with some flexibility on hybrid

Close support from a delivery team that works together, and direct exposure to the founders

Responsibilities
Prepare and deliver training sessions, onboarding and workshops for customer teams
Coordinate rollouts across business units and user groups, sequencing and tracking who goes live when
Build and maintain training materials, guides and walkthroughs
Be the day-to-day contact for users on the accounts you support
Test new workflows and customisations before they go to customers, and gather feedback afterwards
Track delivery progress, actions and follow-ups so nothing slips between meetings
Capture what customers ask for, struggle with and care about, and relay it clearly to the delivery and product team
Collaborate with platform engineers when deeper platform changes are needed
Over time, solve customer problems directly using the platform and its AI tooling
What We're Looking For
Curious and quick to learn new tools, including AI tools, and comfortable using them in your own work; modelling, data or light scripting experience is a plus
Strong problem solver: takes ownership and finds a way through, rather than waiting to be told
Excellent structured communicator, in person and in writing
Organised across several workstreams at once
Confident in front of customers: can run a training session or workshop on your own
Comfortable with ambiguity and change in an early-stage startup
Interest in construction or infrastructure is a plus, but not required

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (US/Defense)
description:
About the Role
We're building
context/fab
, a venture-backed industrial AI startup building the
agentic operating system for the future of manufacturing
.
Our vision is the
self-aware factory
: factories that understand their own equipment, processes, data and operational context, and where AI agents can reason across this context to solve real manufacturing problems.
context/fab automatically connects fragmented industrial data and knowledge into a
Context Graph
, providing the foundation for agents across production, quality, maintenance, logistics and engineering.
We work directly with
large industrial enterprises and leading SMEs
, bringing this technology into real factories and operational workflows.
As our
Forward Deployed Engineer
, you'll work directly with customers from discovery through deployment and expansion. You'll understand how their factories operate, identify high-value problems, connect their systems and data to context/fab, and configure and deploy agents that deliver measurable operational impact.
What You'll Do
Work directly with customers to understand their factories, workflows, systems and most valuable operational problems
Lead technical discovery, workshops and use-case definition together with customer operations, engineering and IT teams
Translate manufacturing problems into agents and custom capabilities for the customer and measurable success criteria
Build, configure and deploy agents and workflows for production, quality, maintenance, logistics and engineering use cases
Connect customer data across PLCs and industrial protocols such as OPC UA and MQTT, SCADA and historians, MES, ERP, QMS, CMMS, databases, APIs and technical documentation
Use our automated Context Graph capabilities to contextualize factory data and validate the resulting representation together with customer experts
Work closely with customers during pilots and rollouts, troubleshoot issues and continuously improve the solution
Identify recurring customer needs and translate field learnings into clear requirements for our product and engineering teams
Support technical sales and solution discovery for new customers
What Makes You a Great Fit
Strong technical foundation across software, data or industrial systems
Product-minded and excited about discovering and deeply understanding customer problems
Comfortable working directly with engineers, plant teams, operations leaders and enterprise IT
Experience with Python, APIs, databases or data integration
Experience with manufacturing, industrial systems, AI agents or enterprise software is a strong plus
Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong bias for ownership, urgency and building from zero to one in ambiguous environments
Naturally driven to take end-to-end responsibility for customer outcomes and to operate with the autonomy of a founder inside a customer context
Willing to travel regularly to customer sites
Fluent in English; German or other European languages are a plus
Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, Data Science or a related field,
or equivalent practical experience
Strong communication skills and comfort operating independently in a fast-moving environment
This role is dedicated to deployments of context/fab in U.S. defense, aerospace and ITAR-controlled manufacturing environments. It requires eligibility for a U.S. security clearance and the ability to meet ITAR and customer facility-access requirements. These requirements apply only to this role, not our general FDE openings.
Why Join Us
Build the
agentic operating system for the self-aware factory
Work directly with large industrial enterprises and leading SMEs on real production problems
Shape both our product and how it is deployed from an early stage
Work directly with the founders and a highly technical team
Help build deep-tech capabilities that keep manufacturing competitive in Europe
Competitive salary and meaningful early equity
Grow faster than almost anywhere else: experience a 10-year career in 2 years

fab
